defect: The fix moves the hand-over of union_readers[0] to initial_reader from bind to ReadCSVInitGlobal, because the InitGlobal reset of initial_reader added by 8a50d9b on 2023-04-04 discarded the first union reader.
reason: The move of union_readers[0] into initial_reader existed before this change, which only relocated it; the defect arose when a later commit added bind_data.initial_reader.reset() in InitGlobal.

defect: The fix turns the test-only debug flag back to false and gives RunFull's skip parameter a nullptr default.
reason: Both the change and the fix touch only a test helper; a leftover debug printout in a test is not a product defect.

defect: single_thread_make_shared allocates an _object_and_block<T> with new but release() calls delete on ptr, the address of its member object, which is undefined behaviour (wrong type and size freed, counter block never freed as such).
reason: The fix makes the block derive from RefCounter and deletes the whole block through ref_count, repairing the mismatched delete that this new file introduced in release() and single_thread_make_shared.

defect: The fix adds an IS NOT NULL filter to the generated enum query so that pivoting on a column with NULL values no longer fails creating the ENUM, and rejects constant and subquery pivot expressions.
reason: The enum query already included NULLs when pivoting on a plain column name before this change (PhysicalCreateType throws on NULL), so the NULL failure predates the switch to pivot expressions.

defect: The fix replaces erasing the first name of a qualified column reference with ReplaceOrRemoveTableName, so that all qualifiers up to the table name are removed in CreateIndexInfo::ToString.
reason: The fix's own message calls it a theoretical issue: erasing the first part of schema.table.col still yields a valid table.col reference, and the binder qualifies index columns with the table name only, so no wrong result is shown.

defect: The fix replaces keeping only the last column name with ColumnRefExpression::ReplaceOrRemoveTableName in RemoveOrderQualificationRecursive.
reason: For column references of two to four parts ReplaceOrRemoveTableName also strips every qualifier up to the last name, so the fix is a behaviour-preserving refactor that the fix itself calls theoretical.

defect: The new memory-leak test uses the C99 designated array initializer char str[] = {[41] = '\1'}, which is not valid C++ and breaks compilation of the unittest (part of test_memory_leak in the unity build) on GCC and MSVC.
reason: The fix, titled Fix compilation, replaces exactly this added initializer with char str[41] and moves rand_str's definition, so the build break lies in lines this change added.

defect: The new check in the RType::DATE case reports the copy-pasted message "DATE_INTEGER should really be integer", naming the wrong type in the user-facing error.
reason: The fix corrects only this message, which this change added to the DATE branch when it split DATE from DATE_INTEGER; it is a minor but real wrong output.

defect: The fix adds a redundant !IsInvalidSchema(schema) guard to the new fallback (that branch is only reached with a valid schema) and updates did_you_mean.test and attach_sequence.test to the new catalog-qualified outputs.
reason: The code edit does not change behaviour and the test edits accept the change's new output rather than repair it, so no defect is fixed.

defect: The new PythonFilesystem declares OpenFile and Read with the glibc-internal types __uint8_t and __int64_t instead of uint8_t and int64_t, which do not exist on MSVC, so the Python package fails to compile on Windows.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these non-portable types that this new header introduced with the standard ones used by the FileSystem base class.

defect: The new finalize condition requires ht.Count() < PARALLEL_CONSTRUCT_THRESHOLD && skew > SKEW_SINGLE_THREADED_THRESHOLD, so large skewed builds still finalize in parallel (the case the change meant to fix) and small unskewed builds lose their single-threaded finalize.
reason: The fix turns exactly this added && into ||, matching the change's own comment that skewed data should go single-threaded; the wrong condition is a performance logic error in the added lines.

defect: In this header the fix only deletes the max_string_length member, whose sole use (a D_ASSERT in compression.cpp) it removes; the defects it repairs (uncompressed and compressed FSST input aliasing the same buffer, symbol-table alignment, string_lengths_space not recomputed) are in compression.cpp.
reason: The header lines this change added are not where the repaired defects lie; removing an unused member is cleanup.

defect: The fix makes a child pipeline depend on every union pipeline scheduled together with its dependency (tracked via scheduled_pipelines), changing SchedulePipeline's signature to collect them.
reason: The unification of SchedulePipeline and ScheduleUnionPipeline preserved the old event chaining; the missing child-pipeline dependencies on union pipelines lay in ScheduleChildPipeline, which this change did not touch.

defect: The fix makes a child pipeline depend on all union pipelines scheduled with its dependency instead of only the main dependency pipeline.
reason: This change only moved parameters into ScheduleEventData and reformatted; the dependency loop in ScheduleChildPipeline that the fix repairs is unchanged from before it.

defect: The fix turns the free function GetSystemPager into a ShellState member so that .pager on can fill pager_command eagerly, and rewrites test_pager.py to the new pager semantics.
reason: In shell.cpp the fix only changes the function's scope; the pager already resolved the system pager lazily in ShouldUsePager, so the follow-up is a behaviour adjustment and test update, not a repaired defect.

defect: The fix removes the D_ASSERT in Pack (leading_zero plus significant bits, counting 0 as full width, must fit the type), which fails once Patas calls Pack with byte_count and trailing_zero and the chimp caller passes the leading-zero representation.
reason: When this change added the assertion, Pack's only caller (chimp128) passed real leading zeros and significant_bits = BIT_SIZE - leading - trailing, so it held; it became wrong with the later reuse of Pack by Patas (c93baa0, 2022-10-13).

defect: The fix makes the batch helper methods private again after the change had made them public.
reason: Changing an access specifier on helper methods is an interface cleanup with no runtime effect; the fix's real work for the benchmarks lies elsewhere.

defect: The fix converts space indentation to tabs, drops blank lines and renames the loop variable i to column_idx.
reason: The fix is a formatting change; the change's real problems (debug couts, cardinality computed from offset) had already been rewritten by intermediate commits before it.

defect: The fix reformats RegisterVectorizedUDF's signature and passes return_type_p as const shared_ptr reference to satisfy clang-tidy in CI.
reason: Passing the shared_ptr by value predates this change and is a lint finding, not a functional defect; the fix is style.

defect: The fix moves func into PythonUDFData instead of copying it, to satisfy clang-tidy in CI.
reason: An avoidable std::function copy is a performance lint, not a defect, and the line it touches is in later code (CreateUDFInternal), not a defect from this change.

defect: The fix introduces IsRemappable so that the nested VARIANT type is not treated as a remappable struct or list.
reason: The VARIANT LogicalTypeId was only added on 2025-08-14, months after this change, so using IsNested here was correct when written; the problem came with the new type.

defect: ProbeAndSink prepares the scan structure (PrepareKeys, early return when no key qualifies) before partitioning and never slices keys and payload to the probable rows, so rows sunk for a later round stay in the probe chunk (and an all-filtered chunk returns without sinking), giving wrong results for external left/right/outer joins.
reason: The fix reorders exactly this design (hash and partition all rows first, sink the rest, slice keys/payload, then initialize the scan structure) in the descendant ProbeAndBuild, whose PrepareKeys-first lines come from this change; seeing the outer-join effect needs the ScanStructure code.

defect: GetGlobalSourceState sets probe_count by summing sink.local_hash_tables, but it runs when the pipeline is readied, before any probe-side local hash table exists (and after Finalize cleared them), so probe_count is 0 and MaxThreads always forces a single-threaded source phase.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added lines with children[0]->estimated_cardinality; seeing that the tables are empty at that point requires Pipeline::Ready/ResetSource in another file.

defect: CreateStringUpdate updates min/max in a nested loop that shadows i and runs over all count update strings, including NULL entries whose string data is invalid, for every non-NULL update (issue #599).
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added inner loop with a single update_min_max call for the current string; the shadowed loop over all strings is visible in the diff.

defect: MapExtractBind now takes value_type = child_types[1].second, the LIST type of the map's values, instead of its child type, so map_extract's return type becomes a list of lists and the bind data carries the wrong type.
reason: The old line drilled into the list's child type (child_types()[0].second) and the rewrite dropped that step; the fix restores it with ListType::GetChildType on exactly this line.

defect: The rewrite of CurrentTimeFun::RegisterFunction constructs the ScalarFunction without the name "get_current_time" and registers it via AddFunction(current_time), so the function is registered with an empty name.
reason: The old code passed "get_current_time" and the new constructor call omits it; the fix adds the name back to exactly this line.

defect: In parser.cpp the fix only moves the PGParseContext declaration after the PRAGMA check; the thread-local TopMemoryContext/ErrorContext leak it repairs is fixed in libpg_query (pg_query.c, mcxt.c).
reason: The destructor does nothing while context is null, so the moved declaration changes no behaviour; the leak is in the vendored parser, not in the lines this change added.

defect: The new header-id and checkpoint-iteration checks in ReplayVersion throw SerializationException, which the WAL replay catch blocks treat as a torn WAL and silently ignore, so a WAL that does not match the database file is dropped (and truncated) instead of raising an error.
reason: The fix changes exactly these added throws to IOException so the mismatch surfaces as an error as test_file_matches_wal expects; seeing it requires the catch handlers in WriteAheadLog::Replay, outside the diff.

defect: The fix corrects the new test itself: it expects the formatted checkpoint iterations instead of the literal %d placeholders and builds the other database's WAL path without prefixing test_dir twice.
reason: Both the change and the fix touch only a test; mistakes in a test's expectations and paths are not product defects.

defect: The new STRUCT_EXTRACT check rejects every child whose type is not STRUCT, including SQLNULL, so binding a macro that dereferences a field of a parameter (bound as NULL during macro binding) now fails with a not-a-struct error.
reason: The fix only widens exactly this added condition to also accept SQLNULL; knowing that macro parameters bind as NULL requires the macro binding code.

defect: The fix (issue #1926) avoids formatting a binder error message twice by turning FormatError(idx_t, message) into a variadic template that formats once.
reason: This change only switched the FormatError parameters from string to const string reference; the double formatting of messages containing % predates it.

defect: The fix skips ExceptionFormatValue::Format when no format values are given, so a message containing % is not formatted a second time (issue #1926).
reason: This change only made the msg parameter a const reference without changing behaviour; the unconditional Format call was already there before.

defect: The fix lowers ART::MAX_KEY_LEN from 32768 to 8192 so that the new key-length check actually prevents the original failure on very long index keys.
reason: The failure on overly long ART keys predates this change, which introduced the limit as a partial fix; the follow-up tightens an insufficient threshold rather than repairing something this change broke.

defect: The fix (issue #19211) applies one DISTINCT ON per unique constraint instead of a single DISTINCT ON over the union of all constraint columns, so INSERT OR IGNORE with rows duplicating only one of several constraints keeps just one row.
reason: Before this change the generated MERGE had no DISTINCT ON at all (a FIXME), so source rows conflicting on one of several constraints already both reached the insert; the change only partly addressed it and the fix completes it.

defect: The fix adds a new DEPENDENCY exception type and DependencyException so that a dependency violation invalidates the transaction (fuzzer issue).
reason: The fix only appends to the enum line this change touched and adds a new class; the dependency-violation handling it repairs is unrelated to the ParameterNotResolvedException this change added.

defect: The fix restructures the FSST branch of Vector::GetValue into an early type check followed by the decompression (a style cleanup), checking the physical type instead of the logical type id.
reason: The commit is a code-style cleanup of the added FSST block with the same decompression logic; no failure on a supported input is repaired.

defect: The fix rewrites the nested ifs in StringAnalyze and Compress as early continue statements (a code-style cleanup) with the same behaviour.
reason: Every string is still size-checked and sampled strings are still collected exactly as in the change, so the fix repairs no defect.

defect: The new TableFunctionRef::ToString appends WITH ORDINALITY after BaseToString has already added the alias and column aliases (giving func() AS t(a) WITH ORDINALITY, which does not re-parse), and as committed it even lacks a return statement.
reason: The fix moves WITH ORDINALITY before the alias by applying BaseToString last, repairing the output string built in exactly these added lines.

defect: The fix adapts the test helper compare_result to the reworked CSV scanner (sets num_cols, loops until FinishedIterator and uses Flush into a preallocated chunk).
reason: Both the change and the fix touch only test-helper code that follows a CSV scanner API in flux; it is a test change, not a product defect.

defect: The fix replaces ChangesMade's entries.size() > 0, which no longer compiles against the chunked undo buffer, with head->maximum_size > 0, and starts the buffer with an empty head chunk allocated lazily.
reason: ChangesMade was added on master by 85c0950 (2019-06-25), which is not descended from this change, and reached the reworked file through a merge; the eager 12 KB head chunk is a design choice the fix revises, not a defect.
